applies_to: cash dividend events on Bitget Reality spot rTokens with exchange_ex_date after frozen_at_utc; first untouched events rAVGO and rVST ex 2026-09-21

decision.EXIT: sell before the 20:00 ET cutoff on ex-date eve and buy back at the rung; issued only if (pdr_hat - z*se)*gross - net_high - cost_per_share > 0, i.e. even if the holder would have kept the most
decision.HOLD: issued only if (pdr_hat - z*se)*gross - net_low - cost_per_share <= 0, i.e. not justified even if the holder would have kept the least
decision.NO_SIGNAL: any unresolved input: basis, price, depth for the notional, or a verdict that changes across the net range
decision.BUY: suppressed on every event while Bitget's eligibility snapshot time is unpublished

rung_rationale: the 04:00 ET drop equals the gross dividend in every sample cut and period (docs/m2.md); the 20:00 ET print is fully adjusted only in June/early July

estimate.description: OLS slope of ex-day return on dividend yield, all 127 usable events of the issuer-verified ledger

withholding_note: documented 30% only for events matched to the 2026-07-24 notice; otherwise ASSUMED with the range, per rtoken_faq_2026_06_23
fees: live takerFeeRate of the spot symbol at run time on both legs
liquidity: per-share walk from the latest sampled book of each session; NO_SIGNAL when the notional exceeds the visible top-of-book on a ticker-only symbol
universe: v3 instruments with symbolType=stock and isReality=yes at run time
amendment_policy: this file is never edited; a changed rule is a new file strategy_v2.json
